description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Optum is hiring a Software Engineer (Full Stack) to build and deploy full-stack applications, intelligent automation, and AI-powered solutions for UnitedHealthcare Employer & Individual's Solaris Salesforce platform. The role modernizes sales and operations workflows through scalable software, enterprise integrations, and responsible AI practices.
Software Engineer building Salesforce full-stack applications and AI automations, integrating enterprise APIs and validating secure deployments

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and deploy scalable full-stack applications, intelligent automations, and AI-powered solutions on the Solaris Salesforce platform to address complex business challenges
• Build secure, responsive front-end components and back-end services utilizing Salesforce technologies (Apex, Lightning Web Components) and modern web engineering tools
• Design and integrate robust RESTful/SOAP APIs and data pipelines connecting Solaris with core enterprise systems and AI/machine learning services
• Use enterprise-approved AI tools and modern engineering practices to streamline workflows, automate tasks, and drive continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle
• Apply responsible AI practices, thoroughly testing and validating AI-assisted and automated outputs for accuracy, performance, and security before deployment
• Evaluate emerging technology and AI trends to inform solution design, architectural evolution, and strategic innovation for Sales and Operations
• Participate in code reviews, automated unit testing, debugging, and system performance tuning to ensure software quality and maintainability

Requirements:
• 1+ years of experience in Demonstrated full-stack software engineering experience developing, deploying, and maintaining enterprise web applications
• 1+ years of experience in Demonstrated hands-on development experience with Salesforce technologies (such as Apex, Lightning Web Components/Aura, and SOQL/SOSL)
• 1+ years of experience designing, implementing, and consuming web services and APIs (REST/SOAP) to connect distributed enterprise platforms
• 1+ years of experience in Proficiency in core web development technologies, including modern JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and relational database concepts
• 1+ years of experience in Proven ability to apply responsible engineering practices, conduct rigorous testing, and deliver secure, high-quality code across the software development lifecycle

Preferred:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent software engineering / technical work experience
• Experience with Git version control systems and branching workflows
• Experience with DevOps practices, continuous integration, and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines
• Experience with Salesforce AI capabilities (such as Einstein or Agentforce) or integrating external AI APIs within enterprise Salesforce environments
• Experience working with Salesforce Sales Cloud or Service Cloud in an enterprise healthcare or health benefits setting
• Active Salesforce credentials (e.g., Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I, Administrator, or App Builder)
